sloka: तदेतद्भयमुत्पन्नं त्रायस्वेमां महाबल ।नाशय त्वमिमानद्य तदर्थं बोधितो भवान् ।। ६.६२.१८ ।।
transliteration: tadetadbhayamutpannaṁ trāyasvemāṁ mahābala ।nāśaya tvamimānadya tadarthaṁ bodhito bhavān ।। 6.62.18 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty strong I am, but such is the fear that has been created in me from them. You have been awakened, to destroy them. Reported Ravana."
